objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with a 1-year history of worsening shortness of breath and weight loss.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I’m 56, and over the past year my shortness of breath has been getting worse, and I’ve lost weight too. I’m also still an active smoker with a long history.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or my eyes.

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel stiffness in your joints when you wake up in the morning?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t feel any particular stiffness in my joints when I wake up in the morning.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on?
turns.patient_answer: Doctor: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on? Patient: No, I haven’t been confused and I can think clearly—I’ve been oriented and understanding what’s going on.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having **night sweats**—waking up with your clothes or bedding noticeably damp—at least a few nights recently?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t recall having night sweats or waking up with my clothes or bedding noticeably damp.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or swelling inside your thigh muscle (not just on the skin), especially if it’s getting bigger or painful?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any firm lump or swelling inside my thigh muscles, and I haven’t had any thigh pain or any masses that seem to be getting bigger.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions or unusual spots along the veins on your arm (for example, along the inner arm where veins are more visible)?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I haven’t noticed any unusual skin lesions or new spots along the veins on my arms. I mainly just feel like the shortness of breath has been steadily worsening and I’ve lost weight over the past year.

turns.doctor_question: Have you worked in an environment where you might breathe in metal dust or metal fumes—for example welding, grinding, cutting, machining, construction/renovation with metal, or working in a foundry or metal workshop? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: Yes—I worked in a steel mill in high school and also did construction work before that, so I was around metal dust and fumes at times.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around your joints (for example, fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips), such as bumps that seem to be part of the bone rather than just soft swelling?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around my joints, like bumps on my fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips.

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have pain in your thigh (either one or both thighs)?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t have pain in either thigh, and I haven’t noticed any swelling there either.

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. When you have sex, do you experience pain or discomfort during penetration (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: Doctor: When you have sex, do you experience pain or discomfort during penetration (yes or no)? Patient: No, I don’t have pain or discomfort during penetration.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any scattered skin lesions—like small bumps, spots, or sores—appearing in different areas of your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Doctor: Have you noticed any scattered skin lesions—like small bumps, spots, or sores—appearing in different areas of your body? Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any scattered skin lesions, spots, or sores anywhere on my body.
